dialogue.content: (本日は宜しくお願いします。時間になりましたら、始めさせて頂きます。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for coming today. We'll begin now that it's time.)

dialogue.content: （こんばんは。こちらこそ、よろしくお願い致します）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. Thank you as well.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。始めに、年齢・性別・相談内容を教えて頂けますか。
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 12歳女性で学校に行ってません
dialogue.English: I'm a 12-year-old girl, and I'm not going to school.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとう。学校に行っていない事についてもう少し詳しく教えてもらえるかな？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. Could you tell me a little more about not going to school?

dialogue.content: いつごろから学校に行っていないのかな
dialogue.English: How long has it been since you stopped going to school?

dialogue.content: 2週間前から友達と喧嘩して行かなくなりました
dialogue.English: I had a fight with a friend two weeks ago, and I haven't gone since.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それはつらかったですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのような事で喧嘩になったんですか？
dialogue.English: What was the fight about?

dialogue.content: 物を盗みました、許せません
dialogue.English: She stole something from me, and I can't forgive her.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。それは腹がたちますよね。
dialogue.English: I understand. That would make anyone angry.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その時、お友達には何て言ったんですか？
dialogue.English: What did you say to your friend at the time?

dialogue.content: 盗まないでよ、と言いました
dialogue.English: I said, 'Don't steal from me.'

dialogue.content: ええ。お友達の反応はどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. And how did your friend react?

dialogue.content: 盗んでないと、言いました
dialogue.English: She said she didn't steal it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですか。意見がちがったんですね。
dialogue.English: Is that so? So you had different views on what happened.

dialogue.content: はい、意見が違いました
dialogue.English: Yes, our views were different.

dialogue.content: それはモヤモヤした気持ちになるかと思いますが、どのように感じましたか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine that would leave you feeling unsettled. How did you feel?

dialogue.content: 何で盗むのか、なぜうそをつくのか、
dialogue.English: Why would she steal? Why would she lie about it?

dialogue.content: ええ。ええ。うそをつかれると、許せないし、悲しくもなりますね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Being lied to can feel unforgivable and very sad.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もしよかったら、その物がどんなものだったか教えてくれませんか。
dialogue.English: If you're comfortable, could you tell me what was stolen?

dialogue.content: 国語の教科書です
dialogue.English: It was my Japanese language textbook.

dialogue.content: 私の
dialogue.English: Mine.

dialogue.content: さらに言えば、古典の教科書です
dialogue.English: To be more specific, it was the classical literature textbook.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。授業で使う大切なもの何に困ってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: I see. That's something important for class, so that must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのお友達とは、それまでどのような関係だったんですか？
dialogue.English: What was your relationship with that friend like before this happened?

dialogue.content: とっても仲が良かったのかな？
dialogue.English: Were you very close?

dialogue.content: 仲良かったです、遊びにも行きましたし、クラスも部活も同じで一緒でした
dialogue.English: We were close. We hung out, and we were in the same class and the same club—we were always together.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。仲良しな友達にそんな事をされると、余計に苦しくなりますね。
dialogue.English: I see. When a close friend does something like that, it hurts even more.

dialogue.content: もういいって思いました
dialogue.English: I just thought, "I've had enough."

dialogue.content: そう思ってしまうのも自然ですよね。がっかりしますものね。
dialogue.English: It's natural to feel that way. It's very disappointing, isn't it?

dialogue.content: がっかりしますが、もう嫌だって思いました
dialogue.English: It is disappointing, and I just thought, "I can't stand this anymore."

dialogue.content: ええ。とても傷いてしまいますね。。
dialogue.English: Yes, it must have hurt a lot.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのことについて、先生には相談したりしましたか？
dialogue.English: Did you talk to a teacher about it?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。先生に言ってどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. How did that go when you told the teacher?

dialogue.content: 先生は、話にならないから、話す必要ないと思いました
dialogue.English: The teacher was useless, so I felt there was no point in talking to them.

dialogue.content: せっかく先生に相談したのに、理解されなかったのですね。悔しいね。
dialogue.English: So you went to the trouble of talking to your teacher, but you weren't understood. That must be frustrating.

dialogue.content: 悔しいというか、頼りにならないなと感じました
dialogue.English: More than frustrating, I just felt I couldn't rely on them.

dialogue.content: そうですか。頼れなかったんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You felt you couldn't rely on them.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、家族の方にはお話されましたか？
dialogue.English: By the way, have you spoken to your family about it?

dialogue.content: お母さんには話しました
dialogue.English: I told my mom.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。お母さんに話してみてどうでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. How did it go when you talked to your mom?

dialogue.content: 学校に行きなさいの言葉ばかりで、話になりませんでした
dialogue.English: She just kept saying 'Go to school,' and it didn't lead anywhere.

dialogue.content: なるほど。。お母さんもなかなか理解してもらえずに、気持ちの行き場がなくなってしまいますね。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's hard when even your mom doesn't understand, and you have nowhere to turn with your feelings.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: そんな中、相談に来てくれてありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming to talk in the midst of all this.

dialogue.content: それで、ここに来たんです
dialogue.English: That's why I came here.

dialogue.content: ええ。一緒に考えたいなと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'd like to think this through together with you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今、学校に行かない時間はどのように過ごしているのですか？
dialogue.English: How are you spending your time while not going to school right now?

dialogue.content: 自宅で勉強してます。少しは遊んでますが
dialogue.English: I've been studying at home. And playing a little.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。自分で勉強をしているのは、素晴らしいですね。少しは遊んでいいと思いますよ。。
dialogue.English: I see. It's wonderful that you're studying on your own. I think it's good to play a little too.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 勉強は好きなんですか？
dialogue.English: Do you like studying?

dialogue.content: 好きではないけど、学校の人間が嫌だから1人でやったほうが楽
dialogue.English: Not really, but I don't like the people at school, so it's easier to do it alone.

dialogue.content: そういう勉強のスタイルもありますね。今後、学校に戻る事についてはどのように思っているのかな。
dialogue.English: That's a valid way to study too. What are your thoughts about going back to school in the future?

dialogue.content: 先生は、バカで信用できない。アイツも人間失格最低、そんなところ、行きたくない。謝れって感じ
dialogue.English: The teacher is an idiot I can't trust. She's a total failure as a human being—the worst. I don't want to go to a place like that. I feel like they should apologize.

dialogue.content: そっかあ。そんな気持ちになるよね。一人で学校に行かずに頑張って勉強しているんですもの。
dialogue.English: I understand. It makes sense you'd feel that way. You're working hard studying by yourself instead of going to school.

dialogue.content: 頑張ってはないですが、楽なんだな1人はと最近感じてます
dialogue.English: I wouldn't say I'm working hard, but I've been feeling lately that it's easier to be alone.

dialogue.content: そうんなんですね。一人で勉強を続けていけそうですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think you can continue studying on your own?

dialogue.content: 仕方ないです
dialogue.English: I have no choice.

dialogue.content: そうですか。もし先生やお友達が謝ったら、どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. What if the teacher or your friend apologized?

dialogue.content: 考えます
dialogue.English: I'd think about it.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。
dialogue.English: I understand.

dialogue.content: はい、学校は行くものとは基本考えてます
dialogue.English: Yes, basically I think school is something you should go to.

dialogue.content: そのような考えを持っているのですね。例えば、校長先生にお話ししてみるのはどうでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see that's your view. For example, how would you feel about speaking with the principal?

dialogue.content: そこまでは良いかと思いますが、校長が自宅に来たら全て話す。仲良かったのに、物を盗みなんて普通ないじゃないですか！
dialogue.English: I'd be okay with that, but if the principal came to my home, I'd tell them everything. We were close, and stealing something—it's not normal, is it?!

dialogue.content: ええ。今までお話を聞いて、あなたはが感じる事はとっても人として自然な感情だと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. From what you've shared so far, I think your feelings are completely natural as a person.

dialogue.content: 先生は相談のるよと言われても、結局お前がテニスの試合で失敗して、ペアにしっかり謝罪しない、だから優勝逃したって！そんな相談あると思いますか？
dialogue.English: The teacher said they'd listen, but in the end, they said, "You messed up in the tennis match, you didn't apologize properly to your partner, and that's why you lost the championship!" Do you think that's what counseling is?!

dialogue.content: それで物盗んで私に復讐！ありえない！
dialogue.English: And then she steals from me as revenge for that! It's unbelievable!

dialogue.content: 先生にそんな風にいわれたんですね。
dialogue.English: So the teacher said that to you.

dialogue.content: それは話がちがってきますね。
dialogue.English: That changes the story completely.

dialogue.content: 私を私を。悔しい悔しすぎます
dialogue.English: Me, me... I'm so frustrated—it's too much.

dialogue.content: 私だってわざとミスしたわけではない！
dialogue.English: It's not like I made the mistake on purpose!

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: I agree.

dialogue.content: すいません、取り乱しました
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I lost my composure.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: It's okay.

dialogue.content: もう学校なんて行かない！
dialogue.English: I'm never going to school again!

dialogue.content: いっぱい、悔しい事、許せいない事、ためてたんですね。
dialogue.English: You've been holding in so many frustrating, unforgivable things.

dialogue.content: もう信用誰もしません！
dialogue.English: I won't trust anyone anymore!

dialogue.content: ええ。信用したくなりなりますね。ただ、あなた自身は大切にしてくださいね。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's understandable not to want to trust. But please take care of yourself.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: 学校は行きません
dialogue.English: I'm not going to school.

dialogue.content: 一つ提案ですが、今の気持ちをそのままぶつけてみてはどうでしょうか。お母さんでも、学校の校長でもいいかと思います。
dialogue.English: One suggestion: How about expressing your feelings directly as they are? To your mom or the school principal, for example.

dialogue.content: お母さんにはぶつけました、ダメでした。では、校長に言います
dialogue.English: I already expressed them to my mom, and it was no use. Then, I'll tell the principal.

dialogue.content: そうですか。あなたが、理不尽な理由で盗みをされたり、相談に乗ってもられない事を知ってもらいことが大切だと思います。
dialogue.English: I see. I think it's important for them to know that you had something stolen for an unjust reason and that you weren't given proper support when you sought help.

dialogue.content: まだ12歳で、、人生いや
dialogue.English: I'm only 12, and I hate my life...

dialogue.content: やるせない気持ちのなか、よく２週間たえてきましたね。
dialogue.English: You've endured these two weeks so well, feeling so helpless.

dialogue.content: もう本当は人生終わりたいと考えてました
dialogue.English: To be honest, I was thinking about ending my life.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I hear you.

dialogue.content: 今はどのようなお気持ちですか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.content: 校長には学校に明日乗り込んでぶつけようと思います。誰の目も気にしない！もうやることはやると
dialogue.English: I'm going to go to the school tomorrow and confront the principal. I don't care what anyone thinks! I'm going to do what I have to do.

dialogue.content: ええ。素敵です。応援しています。本当に。今日はお時間になってしまいましたが、ぜひ結果をお知らせにまたお越しいただければと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. That's wonderful. I'm rooting for you. I really am. Our time is up for today, but I hope you'll come back and let me know how it goes.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you for today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらで終了させて頂きます。応援しています。フレーフレー！
dialogue.English: We'll end the session here. I'm cheering for you. Go for it!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you.
